title: Week 2 - Baseline
description: Setup notes, one example parse, assertions-enabled baseline and its findings.

title: Week 3 - Failure reporting
description: A bounded failure-reporting fix or a precise proposal with evidence (B01, B02).

title: Week 4 - Input matrix
description: An input matrix with reviewed expected outcomes; 50-100 W3C cases (G01).

title: Week 5 - Regressions
description: Repeatable regressions and small bug reproductions (C02, C03, C10). Review what is realistic.

title: Week 7 - Comparison
description: A table of matches, differences and untested cases, xpact vs Expat (A04, G03).

title: Week 10 - Handover
description: Final report, tests, code or proposals, setup guide and follow-up list.
